description.narrative: Sida represented by the Embassy in Belgrade, Serbia entered into Agreement with the organisation Belgrade Open School (BOS) in Belgrade, with the purpose to finance through a grant the implementation of the proposed BOS programme for Serbia 2016-2020 “CS4EU – Civil Society as a Force for a Change in the Serbia’s EU Accession Process” (Contribution number 55100008). The Embassy decided to commission external Monitoring services to be continuously performed throughout the of the Project implementations, and to oversee all the tasks and metrics necessary to ensure that the approved Project is within scope, on time, and on budget so that the Project proceeds with minimal risk and that it maintains potential that its outcomes are delivered. This process involves comparing actual performance with planned performance and taking corrective action to yield the desired outcome when significant differences exist.

The purpose of the Project is to support and enhance EU integration related reforms in Serbia through advanced role of civil society organisations and media, and BOS Serbia remains responsible for planning, implementation and monitoring of the programme. The fact that BOS is a local civil society organisation that strongly aims to promote democratic society and European values, is one of the main reasons that brings an added value and quality in the relationship with their partners as sharing the vision and goals is a possible success factor for the intervention. The Embassy decided to commission external Monitoring services to: - Assess the Project reports (Inception, Semi Annual, Annual and Final); - Assess the Project implementation; - Participate in Annual Project Review meetings. In addition, the external Monitoring provided advice the Embassy with regards to the BOS Serbia Project and its perspectives to reach the set goals: performance, reporting, cost, control risk, control quality, control schedule, control scope, verification and possible change control, and to advice on possible corrective measures. The assignment commenced in February 2017 and continue up to the December 2019. The maximum amount that can be reached is 500 000 SEK. The assignment included desk work and field visits, and subsequent reports to the Embassy/Sida.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
